title: AI-Native Marketing Agency
description: Reusable vertical structure for B2B marketing agencies and consultancies that combine accountable senior expertise, connected capabilities and AI-supported production.

conditional_patterns.if: The business offers a bounded diagnostic or audit as a distinct acquisition route.
Real completed client/project cases are available and permitted for publication.

pages.purpose: Explain the inherited process as a transparent method from evidence and decisions through demand and implementation.
Present accountable expertise, operating model and the boundaries of human and AI responsibility.
Present heterogeneous proof such as track record, pilots, self-projects or external cases with honest provenance and status labels.
Provide a content hub when enough substantive content exists to support demand and authority.

conditional_rules.if: The buyer has an internal marketing owner/team.
conditional_rules.then: Present responsibility boundaries and collaboration model explicitly.
Explain human responsibility and AI role without making AI the primary value proposition.

conditional_rules.if: Publishable proof exists and benefits from a dedicated collection page.
conditional_rules.then: Include an experience page and label proof by its real provenance and status.

conditional_rules.if: Enough substantive content exists to justify a content hub.

constraints: Commercial architecture is primarily demand or situation-led rather than a generic long service catalog.
AI is a supporting operating model or reason to believe, not automatically the primary value proposition.
Do not claim replacement of an entire internal marketing team unless that scope is genuinely defined.
Do not fabricate prices, clients, results, testimonials, metrics or cases.
Founder experience, pilots, self-projects and external client cases must remain distinguishable.
A self-project must not be represented as an external client case.
Distinct primary demand or search intents must not be merged merely for navigation simplicity.
Use one primary conversion route per page unless a genuinely distinct lower-friction route is intentional.
Internal IDs must not automatically become public labels.
Methodology or process must not imply a guaranteed outcome.
Synthetic research must not be represented as real customer research.
